recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce local FHIR copies of DICOM terminology for this historical issue; future changes to current DICOM terminology content should go through the DICOM-authored terminology/package path.
issue_request: FHIR-13122 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 vocabulary issue asking FHIR core to fix three DICOM OIDs: add 1.2.840.10008.2.16.4 to the DICOM Controlled Terminology code system, use 1.2.840.10008.6.1.908 for DICOM CID 405 media type, and use 1.2.840.10008.6.1.811 for Instance Availability.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN/git commit 760cb60ceb (svn 14623), which added the DICOM code system identifier and corrected the CID 405 and Instance Availability value set OIDs in the then-active hand-maintained source files.
additional_context: FHIR-24908 later concluded that FHIR core should eliminate duplicate hand-coded DICOM value sets and use DICOM-authored terminology. Commit 26f1439636 removed the local CID 405 media type value set, and commit b3994b69a3 removed the local DICOM code system because it now comes from DICOM directly. Current source retains DICOM import/fixup inputs, not the old editable OID-bearing XML files.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original requested OIDs are present in historical generated R4 artifacts, and current FHIR core no longer owns the affected DICOM code system/value set definitions as editable source files.
